_provenance.note: New York citation authorities. OTDA directives: ADM (Administrative Directive), INF (Informational Letter), LCM (Local Commissioners Memorandum), GIS (General Information System messages — file IDs like 25DC059; older text style 'GIS 21 TA/DC079' normalizes to the same ID). Regulations: 18 NYCRR Part 387 (SNAP) + §385.3 (work rules) — the state-designated NYCRR reader (govt.westlaw.com) is a JS app and self-labeled 'Unofficial'; section text was verified via the LII mirror (flagged) and the Source Book's reproductions. Forms (LDSS-4826, LDSS-4310, LDSS-5166, LDSS-3938, LDSS-4753) are referenced in prose, not extracted as citations.
